Title: Implement Schema Consumption Interface
Description: Create robust schema loader with fallback handling for loading DUX object schemas. Foundation for all object extraction. Check cache first, load from current archive location, handle path changes gracefully, validate schema structure, cache for performance.

Title: Build Core Extraction Pipeline
Description: Create automated pipeline with Core schemas replacing manual extraction processes. Main orchestrator with schema validation at extraction time, object factory for each DUX type, error handling and logging, extraction metrics.

Title: Implement Agent Prompt Loading System
Description: Create dynamic prompt loading from Core for consistent extraction across studies. Load appropriate prompt template, cache loaded prompts, handle version changes. Check multiple Core locations during infrastructure transition.

Title: Create Validation Feedback Loop to Core
Description: Build systematic failure reporting to improve schemas based on real usage. Categorize failure types, suggest schema improvements, log to shared location, generate reports for Core team.

Title: Build Training Data Management System
Description: Create organized training data pipeline to improve extraction accuracy. Training data repository structure, import canonical examples from Core, build validation set from approved objects, implement versioning, create evaluation metrics.

Title: Implement Relationship Extraction Pipeline
Description: Extract full relationship graph instead of isolated objects. DUX value comes from connections. Problem → UserOutcome links, UserOutcome → Behavior + Result, All → Provenance evidence chains, Build Neo4j relationships.

Title: Add Quality Scoring System
Description: Replace binary valid/invalid with granular quality metrics to prioritize high-quality extractions. Define quality dimensions (completeness, evidence strength), implement scoring algorithms, create quality dashboards, add quality-based filtering.

Title: Build Extraction Monitoring and Alerting
Description: Create comprehensive monitoring and alerting for operational excellence. Add extraction metrics (success rate, time, volume), create monitoring dashboards, implement alerting for failures, add performance tracking.

Title: Create Batch Processing System
Description: Enable efficient batch operations to scale to large research studies. Implement parallel extraction, add progress tracking, create resumable pipelines, optimize for throughput.

Title: Implement Extraction Versioning and Lineage
Description: Add version tracking for reproducibility and debugging. Version extraction runs, track schema versions used, log prompt versions, enable extraction replay.

Title: Build Study-Specific Template System
Description: Create customizable extraction templates per study to optimize for specific research needs. Template system, allow study-specific overrides, build template library, share successful templates.

Title: Implement Multi-Model Extraction Strategy
Description: Use best model for each task to optimize quality and cost. Benchmark models per object type, implement model routing, add fallback strategies, create cost optimization.

Title: Create Active Learning Pipeline
Description: Enable learning from corrections for continuous improvement. Track extraction corrections, retrain on corrections, implement confidence scoring, add human-in-the-loop for low confidence.

Title: Build Cross-Study Analytics System
Description: Generate research meta-insights across studies. Build cross-study object database, implement pattern detection, create insight synthesis, generate research trends.
